required_human_action_per_item.required_action: Provide verifiable environment name, owner, locator and purpose without secrets.
Provide documentary proof the environment is dev, local, ephemeral or otherwise non-productive.
Provide proof the target is not production DB.
Provide proof the target is not productive Supabase.
Provide credential class evidence without exposing secret values.
Provide proof no productive credentials are used.
Provide proof no production data is present or production data has been scrubbed.
Provide secret boundary documentation without secret values.
Provide network isolation or local-only evidence.
Provide tenant data policy evidence for the non-productive target.
Provide target database identity evidence.
Provide target schema identity evidence.
Provide schema baseline capture plan.
Provide RLS baseline capture plan if applicable.
Provide constraints baseline capture plan.
Provide snapshot or restore-point plan.
Provide rollback or abandon plan.
Provide path where validation evidence will be recorded.
Provide approval route before execution.
Provide accountable risk owner.
Provide explicit attestation that no production access is present.
